corpus.note: Line numbers are valid only for this commit. Clone with --depth 1 and check out this sha before scoring. The source is NOT committed: it is third-party code, and the provenance rule keeps it out of the repository.

fields.file: the file holding the answer. REQUIRED, because this corpus has 19 files and line 186 exists in most of them
fields.expects: the lines in that file that really answer the question
fields.asks: what kind of thing the question wants: constant, behaviour, error, api, structure
fields.wording: named = the question uses a word that also appears in the code. paraphrase = the question deliberately avoids the words used by the code.
